LASK have won two, drawn one, and lost two of their last five outings. Their most recent result was a 4-0 win over Austria Lustenau in the Bundesliga on October 17, but that followed a 6-3 Champions League defeat to Liverpool and a 2-0 loss to Rapid Wien. LASK drew 3-3 with Hartberg and won 2-1 against First Vienna FC in the other two matches, scoring ten goals and conceding sixteen across the five games.
